correctness.rationale: The upper bound follows from the published reachability bound applied to the acyclic part orientation \(C\to B\to A\): reachable-set sizes are \(1\), \(3\), and \(6\) on the three parts, so six colors suffice for every preference profile. For the lower bound, the package gives a fully specified five-color preference profile. I independently reconstructed properness and envy arcs from those rankings and exhaustively replayed all \(5^8\) maps; exactly \(2940\) are proper and none has an acyclic envy digraph. The packaged verifier was read line by line and separately checks one blocking cycle for every proper coloring, so the finite obstruction is exhaustive rather than sampled.
correctness.risk: The lower bound is a graph-specific finite certificate and does not imply a formula for larger complete multipartite graphs.
